sampling_proposal.scope: Only a corpus admitted after source/legal/privacy + human-label audit
sampling_proposal.unit: Connected components sharing review entity/group source or normalized-text duplicate; keep each component within a single fold.
sampling_proposal.split: Provisional 60% train / 20% validation / 20% independent test by group; adjust based on group sizes and per-class feasibility before opening test.
sampling_proposal.calibration: Within training only, group-disjoint inner folds
sampling_proposal.labeling: Written, pre-registered mapping; label adjudication or clear weak-rating provenance; ambiguous labels excluded from gold or independently adjudicated
sampling_proposal.hidden_competition_test: Excluded from model selection/training and all custom gold evaluations
sampling_proposal.near_duplicates: Exact normalized-text check automated locally; semantic near-duplicate review still manual pending
sampling_proposal.release_policy: Only aggregate metrics/metadata and permitted models; no restricted texts or identifiers
